node.statement: The second row of M_lambda is (0,1-lambda,0,lambda), so the second row of M_lambda A_lambda is (1-lambda)row_2(A_lambda)+lambda row_4(A_lambda)=(1-lambda)(0,1)+lambda(lambda,1-lambda)=(lambda^2,1-lambda+lambda-lambda^2)=(lambda^2,1-lambda^2). These are all rows of the 2-by-2 product, proving 1.6.
